env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A field default is removed from the declaration whatever it ends in: a
# composite literal, a parenthesis, an operator expression, a string holding
# closers, a raw string over two lines, or a literal followed by a struct
# tag or a line comment. The module runs natively, ejects, and the ejected
# module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and
# prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^a\)\}// \[1 2\] \{3\} map\[k:\[1\]\] 5 14 \[x \)\] 3 8080$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/structdefault

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Item struct{ N int }

type Cfg struct {
	Name  string = "a)}//"
	Items []int = []int{1, 2}
	One   Item = Item{N: 3} // trailing
	Gen   map[string][]int = map[string][]int{"k": {1}}
	Last  int = (5)
	Calc  int = 2 * (3 + 4)
	Arr   [2]string = [2]string{"x", ")"}
	Raw   string = `r
)`
	Port int32 = 8080 `json:"port"`
}

func main() {
	c := Cfg{}
	fmt.Println(c.Name, c.Items, c.One, c.Gen, c.Last, c.Calc, c.Arr, len(c.Raw), c.Port)
}
